purpose: A two-axis search space whose best point is only reachable by changing both axes at once. Used to show that a greedy, one-change-at-a-time search (research F04) cannot find a coordinated improvement, and as the oracle for any replacement search kernel.
not_a_claim: The axes, options and payoffs are invented numbers. They model no PoE 2 skill, support or passive.

oracle.reason: Every single-axis change from the baseline loses 10 points, so a hill climber restricted to one change per step stops at the baseline.
